site_name: Land South of Creoch Farm, Ochiltree
address: Land South of Creoch Farm, Ochiltree, Cumnock

building_footprint_m2.notes: c.45,000 sqm total footprint; flexible layout of one or more one-to-two storey buildings

previous_land_use: Agricultural; site lies immediately north of the former Killoch Colliery (NCB pithead/washery complex closed as a mine in the 1980s; latterly a depot and washery site). The colliery land itself hosts separate BESS and other proposals but is outside the reported data centre site.
land_notes: Coordinates are approximate: APRS gives 55.457124, -4.412888 for the site; the council portal record point (via PlanIt) is 55.460976, -4.409163. Both fall between Creoch Farm and the former Killoch Colliery off the A70/Creoch Road, c.5 km west of Cumnock. Red-line boundary not obtained, so no boundary.geojson is published. Cumulative energy development context: Westport BESS (150MW, RES) north of Killoch Colliery and a 200MW BESS screening adjacent to Killoch (Jan 2025).
